ops.sql: INSERT INTO tb_purchase_order (f_id, f_order_no, f_supplier, f_category, f_amount, f_status, f_buyer, f_order_date, f_remark, f_create_time) VALUES (@f_id, @f_order_no, @f_supplier, @f_category, @f_amount, @f_status, @f_buyer, @f_order_date, @f_remark, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE f_order_no=@f_order_no, f_supplier=@f_supplier, f_category=@f_category, f_amount=@f_amount, f_status=@f_status, f_buyer=@f_buyer, f_order_date=@f_order_date, f_remark=@f_remark
